sentences.text: Blow a soap bubble.
It is round.
Blow another one.
Also round.
Use a square ring to blow it.
Still round.
Use a star. Use a triangle.
The bubble does not care.
It comes out as a ball every time.
Why can it not be a cube?
sentences.translationRu: Почему он не может быть кубом?

sentences.text: The answer is about being lazy.
A bubble is a thin skin of water.
With soap in it, and air inside.
sentences.translationRu: С мылом внутри и воздухом внутри неё.

sentences.text: The skin is pulling on itself.
Water always does this.
Every part pulls every other part.
So the skin wants to be small.
As small as it possibly can be.
But the air inside will not move out.
sentences.translationRu: Но воздух внутри уходить не собирается.

sentences.text: The amount of air stays the same.
So there is a question to answer.
What shape holds this much air
with the smallest possible skin?
The answer is a ball.
It is always a ball.
A cube holding the same air
needs more skin to do it.
So does a star, and a box, and a tube.
sentences.translationRu: И звезда, и коробка, и труба тоже.

sentences.text: The bubble is not choosing.
It simply cannot stay in another shape.
sentences.translationRu: Он просто не может удержать другую форму.

sentences.text: Now look at two bubbles together.
sentences.translationRu: Теперь посмотри на два пузыря вместе.

sentences.text: The wall between them is flat.
If they are the same size.
If one is bigger, the wall bends.
It bends into the bigger one.
Small bubbles push harder than big ones.
Which surprises most people.
And the same rule works far from soap.
sentences.translationRu: И то же правило работает далеко за пределами мыла.

sentences.text: Rain drops. Planets. Drops of oil in water.
sentences.translationRu: Капли дождя. Планеты. Капли масла в воде.

sentences.text: They are all answering the same question.
sentences.translationRu: Все они отвечают на один и тот же вопрос.

sentences.text: How do I hold this, with the least?
sentences.translationRu: Как удержать это, потратив меньше всего?

title: Why traffic lights are red, yellow and green

sentences.text: Every country uses the same three colours.
sentences.translationRu: Все страны используют одни и те же три цвета.

sentences.text: Red, yellow, green.
In every city in the world.
That is unusual.
Countries agree on almost nothing.
sentences.translationRu: Страны не сходятся почти ни в чём.

sentences.text: They drive on different sides.
They use different plugs.
But the lights are the same.
The story starts with trains.
Long before cars existed.
Railways needed a way to say stop.
sentences.translationRu: Железным дорогам нужен был способ сказать «стоп».

sentences.text: They chose red.
Red was already a danger colour.
Blood is red. Fire is red.
People understood it without being taught.
There is also a physical reason.
Red light travels well through fog and rain.
sentences.translationRu: Красный свет хорошо проходит сквозь туман и дождь.

sentences.text: Better than blue or violet.
So you can see it from far away.
Which is exactly what a stop signal needs.
sentences.translationRu: А стоп-сигналу именно это и нужно.

sentences.text: At first, green meant be careful.
And white meant go.
That was a bad idea.
One night a red lens fell out of a lamp.
sentences.translationRu: Однажды ночью из фонаря выпало красное стекло.

sentences.text: The lamp showed white instead.
A driver saw white and went.
There was a crash.
After that, white was removed.
Green became go.
Yellow was added later, for the middle.
It had to be a colour nothing else used.
sentences.translationRu: Нужен был цвет, который больше нигде не использовался.

sentences.text: And one you can see in sunlight.
The first traffic light for cars
was built in London in 1868.
It was worked by hand, with gas inside.
sentences.translationRu: Им управляли вручную, внутри был газ.

sentences.text: It exploded a few weeks later.
The policeman using it was hurt.
London waited fifty years to try again.
sentences.translationRu: Лондон ждал пятьдесят лет, прежде чем попробовать снова.

sentences.text: One more thing about the order.
Red is always at the top.
This is for people who cannot see colour.
sentences.translationRu: Это ради тех, кто не различает цвета.

sentences.text: They read the position, not the colour.
sentences.translationRu: Они читают положение, а не цвет.

title: The sprinter who took fewer steps than everyone else

sentences.text: A hundred metres is a strange distance.
It lasts under ten seconds.
And it has been studied to exhaustion.
Every part of it is measured.
Reaction time at the gun.
The angle of the body leaving the blocks.
sentences.translationRu: Угол корпуса при выходе из колодок.

sentences.text: The moment of top speed.
The slowing down that always follows.
Speed is two numbers multiplied.
How long each step is.
And how many steps you take per second.
sentences.translationRu: И сколько шагов ты делаешь в секунду.

sentences.text: Raise either one and you go faster.
The problem is that they fight each other.
sentences.translationRu: Проблема в том, что они борются друг с другом.

sentences.text: Longer steps take longer to complete.
Faster steps tend to be shorter.
Most sprinters find a balance in the middle.
They run the hundred in about forty-five steps.
sentences.translationRu: Сотню они бегут примерно за сорок пять шагов.

sentences.text: Usain Bolt ran it in forty-one.
sentences.translationRu: Усэйн Болт пробежал её за сорок один.

sentences.text: Sometimes fewer.
He is about one metre ninety-five.
sentences.translationRu: Его рост около метра девяноста пяти.

sentences.text: Which is very tall for a sprinter.
For a long time coaches thought that was bad.
sentences.translationRu: Долгое время тренеры считали это недостатком.

sentences.text: Tall people get out of the blocks slowly.
Long legs take longer to fold and push.
sentences.translationRu: Длинным ногам нужно больше времени, чтобы согнуться и оттолкнуться.

sentences.text: And Bolt did start slowly.
At thirty metres he was often behind.
sentences.translationRu: На тридцати метрах он часто отставал.

sentences.text: What he did was hold the speed.
Everybody slows down at the end.
The race is partly about slowing least.
sentences.translationRu: Гонка отчасти про то, кто замедлится меньше.

sentences.text: His steps were long enough
that he needed fewer of them to finish.
sentences.translationRu: чтобы закончить дистанцию меньшим их числом.

sentences.text: Fewer steps means less pushing.
Less pushing means less tiring.
There was also something less measurable.
He had a childhood back problem.
sentences.translationRu: У него с детства была проблема со спиной.

sentences.text: It made one side slightly different.
sentences.translationRu: Из-за неё одна сторона немного отличалась.

sentences.text: Coaches usually try to correct that.
His did not try very hard.
The lesson people take is about talent.
sentences.translationRu: Урок, который отсюда выносят, — про талант.

sentences.text: The better lesson is about categories.
He was the wrong shape for the event.
sentences.translationRu: Он был не той формы для своей дисциплины.

sentences.text: Until the event changed shape around him.
sentences.translationRu: Пока дисциплина не изменила форму вокруг него.

title: The job where nothing interesting is the goal

sentences.text: At any moment there are thousands of aircraft
sentences.translationRu: В любой момент в воздухе находятся тысячи самолётов,

sentences.text: in the air, all moving fast, in three dimensions.
sentences.translationRu: все движутся быстро, в трёх измерениях.

sentences.text: None of them can stop.
None of them can reverse.
sentences.translationRu: Ни один не может сдать назад.

sentences.text: All of them are burning fuel while deciding.
sentences.translationRu: И все жгут топливо, пока решение принимается.

sentences.text: Somebody has to keep them apart.
The rules sound almost too simple.
Aircraft must stay a set distance apart.
Usually a few miles sideways.
Or a thousand feet vertically.
Break either number and it is an incident.
sentences.translationRu: Нарушь любое из чисел — и это инцидент.

sentences.text: Reports are filed. Careers are examined.
The difficulty is not the rule.
It is that everything is in motion
sentences.translationRu: А в том, что всё движется,

sentences.text: and the answer has to be given now.
A controller is holding a moving picture
of their whole sector in their head.
Not the screen in front of them.
The screen shows where things are.
The head holds where they will be
in four minutes, if nothing changes.
sentences.translationRu: через четыре минуты, если ничего не изменится.

sentences.text: And a second version where something does.
sentences.translationRu: И вторая версия, где что-то меняется.

sentences.text: This is why the shifts are short.
Typically under two hours at a position.
sentences.translationRu: Обычно меньше двух часов на позиции.

sentences.text: Then a mandatory break.
Not because the work is physically hard.
sentences.translationRu: Не потому, что работа физически тяжела.

sentences.text: Because holding that picture degrades.
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что эта картинка деградирует.

sentences.text: And the person holding it cannot tell.
sentences.translationRu: И тот, кто её держит, этого не замечает.

sentences.text: That last part is the important one.
Fatigue does not announce itself.
So the break is enforced by a clock.
Rather than by how anyone feels.
The language is deliberately unnatural.
Fixed phrases, fixed order, numbers read out.
sentences.translationRu: Фиксированные фразы, фиксированный порядок, цифры вслух.

sentences.text: Pilots read the instruction back.
Which sounds like wasted time.
sentences.translationRu: Что звучит как пустая трата времени.

sentences.text: It is the single most effective safety device
in the whole system.
Most errors are caught in that echo.
sentences.translationRu: Большинство ошибок ловится именно в этом эхе.

sentences.text: The job has an odd shape as a career.
sentences.translationRu: Как карьера эта работа странной формы.

sentences.text: You are judged entirely by absence.
A perfect day produces no evidence.
Nothing happened, and nobody knows
sentences.translationRu: Ничего не случилось — и никто не знает,

sentences.text: how close it came to happening.

title: The studio that kept drawing when it stopped making sense

sentences.text: Animation moved to computers decades ago.
sentences.translationRu: Анимация перешла на компьютеры десятилетия назад.

sentences.text: The reasons were entirely practical.
A hand-drawn film needs every frame drawn.
sentences.translationRu: В рисованном фильме нужно нарисовать каждый кадр.

sentences.text: Twenty-four of them for one second.
A hundred thousand for a feature.
Each one coloured, checked and photographed.
A mistake means redrawing, not undoing.
sentences.translationRu: Ошибка означает перерисовать, а не отменить.

sentences.text: Studio Ghibli kept doing it anyway.
Long after it stopped being the cheap option.
sentences.translationRu: Долго после того, как это перестало быть дешёвым вариантом.

sentences.text: Or the fast one, or the normal one.
Hayao Miyazaki has drawn obsessively
through films he also wrote and directed.
sentences.translationRu: в фильмах, которые сам же писал и ставил.

sentences.text: Which is not how the job is usually divided.
sentences.translationRu: А работу обычно делят не так.

sentences.text: The argument for it is not nostalgia.
sentences.translationRu: Аргумент в пользу этого — не ностальгия.

sentences.text: It is about what a drawing can carry.
sentences.translationRu: А то, что может унести рисунок.

sentences.text: A computer model is consistent by nature.
sentences.translationRu: Компьютерная модель по природе своей последовательна.

sentences.text: The same face, from any angle, correctly.
sentences.translationRu: То же лицо, с любого угла, корректно.

sentences.text: Consistency is exactly what it is for.
sentences.translationRu: Именно для последовательности она и нужна.

sentences.text: A drawing is inconsistent by nature.
And an animator uses that.
A face can be wrong on purpose
for three frames, to sell a reaction.
Nobody sees it. Everybody feels it.
sentences.translationRu: Никто этого не видит. Все это чувствуют.

sentences.text: There is a second thing, harder to argue.
sentences.translationRu: Есть и второе, о чём труднее спорить.

sentences.text: Ghibli films spend time on nothing.
sentences.translationRu: Фильмы Ghibli тратят время ни на что.

sentences.text: A character sits. Wind moves grass.
Somebody cooks, in real time, silently.
sentences.translationRu: Кто-то готовит, в реальном времени, молча.

sentences.text: Miyazaki has a word for these pauses.
sentences.translationRu: У Миядзаки для этих пауз есть слово.

sentences.text: He has described them as the space
between one breath and the next.
Western studios cut such moments.
They test badly and cost the same as action.
sentences.translationRu: Они плохо тестируются и стоят как экшен.

sentences.text: But a film with no empty moments
gives the loud ones nothing to stand on.
sentences.translationRu: не даёт громким на что опереться.

sentences.text: The studio has never been a comfortable place.
sentences.translationRu: Студия никогда не была уютным местом.

sentences.text: The hours are notorious.
Miyazaki has retired several times.
sentences.translationRu: Миядзаки уходил на пенсию несколько раз.

sentences.text: And come back each time.
He has been openly pessimistic about his own field.
sentences.translationRu: Он открыто пессимистичен насчёт собственной индустрии.

sentences.text: And unusually blunt about automated tools.
sentences.translationRu: И необычно резок про автоматические инструменты.

sentences.text: None of which is the interesting part.
The interesting part is the bet.
That a slower method makes a different film.
sentences.translationRu: Что более медленный метод даёт другой фильм.

sentences.text: Not a better-looking one. A different one.
And that audiences can tell
without being able to say what they noticed.
sentences.translationRu: не умея сказать, что именно заметили.

title: Most people alive have never seen the Milky Way

sentences.text: The band of light across the night sky
is the galaxy we are inside, seen edge on.
sentences.translationRu: это галактика, внутри которой мы находимся, с ребра.

sentences.text: For every human generation but the last few
sentences.translationRu: Для всех человеческих поколений, кроме нескольких последних,

sentences.text: it was simply what the sky looked like.
sentences.translationRu: это было просто то, как выглядит небо.

sentences.text: It appears in the mythology of every culture.
sentences.translationRu: Оно есть в мифологии каждой культуры.

sentences.text: Because every culture could see it.
Today roughly a third of humanity cannot.
sentences.translationRu: Сегодня примерно треть человечества не может.

sentences.text: In Europe and North America the figure is far higher.
sentences.translationRu: В Европе и Северной Америке доля куда выше.

sentences.text: The cause is not pollution in the usual sense.
sentences.translationRu: Причина — не загрязнение в обычном смысле.

sentences.text: Nothing is being added to the air.
Light is simply going where it was not aimed.
sentences.translationRu: Просто свет уходит туда, куда не был направлен.

sentences.text: A lamp that lights a car park
also throws light sideways and upward.
sentences.translationRu: светит ещё и вбок, и вверх.

sentences.text: That light hits dust and water in the air.
sentences.translationRu: Этот свет попадает на пыль и воду в воздухе.

sentences.text: And scatters into a dome over the city.
sentences.translationRu: И рассеивается в купол над городом.

sentences.text: Which is brighter than the faintest stars.
So the stars are not hidden by cloud.
sentences.translationRu: То есть звёзды скрыты не облаками.

sentences.text: They are outshone.
The astronomy is the smallest part of the loss.
Almost everything alive reads the day-night cycle.
sentences.translationRu: Почти всё живое читает цикл дня и ночи.

sentences.text: It is the oldest signal on the planet.
Older than eyes, older than land.
Insects navigate by keeping a light at a fixed angle.
sentences.translationRu: Насекомые ориентируются, держа свет под постоянным углом.

sentences.text: That works with the moon, which does not move much.
sentences.translationRu: С луной это работает — она почти не смещается.

sentences.text: It fails with a street lamp, which is close.
sentences.translationRu: С уличным фонарём — нет, он близко.

sentences.text: Holding the angle around a close light
produces a spiral into the bulb.
Which is what you are watching on a summer night.
sentences.translationRu: Это и есть то, что ты видишь летним вечером.

sentences.text: Not attraction. A navigation system failing.
Birds migrating at night are drawn off course.
sentences.translationRu: Птиц, мигрирующих ночью, сносит с курса.

sentences.text: Turtles hatching on a beach go inland.
sentences.translationRu: Вылупившиеся на пляже черепахи уходят вглубь суши.

sentences.text: Because for a hundred million years
the brightest thing was the sea.
What makes this unusual among environmental problems
sentences.translationRu: Среди экологических проблем эта необычна тем,

sentences.text: is how easily it reverses.
It leaves no residue.
Nothing accumulates anywhere.
Switch off a light and the damage stops
at the speed of light, which is the joke.
sentences.translationRu: со скоростью света, в чём и шутка.

sentences.text: Cities that shield their lamps and aim them down
sentences.translationRu: Города, которые экранируют фонари и направляют их вниз,

sentences.text: get their sky back within a year.
sentences.translationRu: получают своё небо обратно за год.

sentences.text: They also use less electricity
sentences.translationRu: И при этом тратят меньше электричества,

sentences.text: because the light is going where it was paid for.
sentences.translationRu: потому что свет идёт туда, за что заплачено.

sentences.text: There are not many problems shaped like that.
